title: Reconstruct fixed-predictor lossless audio with parallel scans

definition.title: Reconstruct fixed-predictor lossless audio with parallel scans
definition.source_excerpt: Treat restricted FLAC fixed-predictor residual reconstruction as prefix sums with exact integer boundaries. Include entropy decoding and complete transfer/output costs.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Write the exact requested signal operation, codec tool constraints, state and rounding contract. Check whether an optimized existing library already performs it.
definition.minimum_probe: A tiny independent numerical/bitstream oracle plus one boundary or adversarial case. Only use a matching Wasm slice when available and inexpensive.
definition.initial_screen: Write the exact requested signal operation, codec tool constraints, state and rounding contract. Check whether an optimized existing library already performs it. A tiny independent numerical/bitstream oracle plus one boundary or adversarial case. Only use a matching Wasm slice when available and inexpensive.
definition.primary_metric: Complete specified audio operation, output sample count/phase and practical CPU/memory or repeated-query cost.
definition.scope_contract: Exact PCM/encoded output where claimed; otherwise declared numeric tolerance against a stronger independent reference, including delay, tails and state.
definition.negative_control: Extrema, invalid precision, changed predictor/phase/history or a nonlinear stage must invalidate assumptions. No covert resampling/downmix/quality change.
definition.stop_boundary: No full DSP pipeline or codec-state subsystem in the first pass. Count preparation/queries and do not promote algebra alone as an integrated gain.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Pinned processing recipe and relevant assets. Distinguish aggregate statistics from waveform, loudness, true peak and physical speaker behavior.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Exact full-key mechanism, bounded workload, matched baseline and predeclared threshold.

prepare.basis: Fixtures, source/runtime hashes, independent PCM oracle, adverse and lifecycle controls pinned.

correctness.basis: Real fixed-order1 FLAC escape-residual entropy traversal feeds compiled four-thread local scans, carry composition and four-thread output correction. All6168 signed16 samples including extrema exactly match independent FFmpeg and compiled serial predictor recurrence. Actual source-read/hash/entropy parser/intermediate file transfer/executable startup/output read and thread creation/join included equally; serial baseline is compiled, not Python-loop comparison. Identity, CRC, truncation, valid-CRC wrong predictor guards reject; omitted carry changes PCM. Five alternating complete jobs103.304ms parallel versus59.639ms serial median ratio1.73214 fails<=0.9; raw timings variable and retained. Original compiled kernel and build command pinned.

performance.basis: Stop this short24-block cold threaded scan profile. Parallel prefix reconstruction is demonstrated only for fixed-order1 escape residuals; measured small workload does not amortize threads/process/transfer costs. Larger blocks, persistent ownership or a different runtime require new declared measurements. No generic Rice decode or full FLAC parallel decoder qualification, and no production edits.

results.basis: New raw measurements and setup costs captured alongside pinned correctness reuse.
